We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026.

**About Position:**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner with strong expertise in the US Healthcare Payer domain and a proven track record of delivering successful digital products and cloud-based solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining product strategy, managing product roadmaps, prioritizing business requirements, and driving successful product delivery in Agile environments. The role requires close collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, UX designers, and product leadership to deliver innovative digital platform solutions. The candidate should possess strong domain knowledge in Healthcare Payer operations, digital portals, cloud technologies, and emerging AI-driven products.

* **Role: Senior Product Owner**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 8 to 14 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

* Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.

* Gather, analyze, and prioritize business requirements from stakeholders and customers.

* Monitor product performance and define KPIs to measure product success.

* Support cloud modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams on API, microservices, integration, and cloud-based solutions.
* Facilitate communication between technical and business stakeholders.
* Manage product risks, dependencies, and delivery challenges.
* Drive adoption of Generative AI capabilities and AI-first product strategies where applicable.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, security, and non-functional requirements.
* Support go-to-market planning and product launch activities.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8?14 years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or Digital Product Lead within the US Healthcare Payer domain.
* Proven experience delivering digital products, cloud-based platforms, and customer-centric solutions.
* Strong understanding of Healthcare Payer business processes, member services, provider operations, and payer ecosystems.
* Deep understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, Kanban practices, and Product Ownership responsibilities.
* Significant experience managing web portals, digital platforms, and customer-facing product solutions.
* Strong ability to convert complex business requirements into actionable product plans and delivery roadmaps.
* Knowledge of web technologies, mobile platforms, UX principles, and customer experience strategies.
* Experience working with Figma or similar design and prototyping tools.
* Strong understanding of cloud technologies including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Familiarity with APIs, microservices architecture, data workflows, and integration platforms.
* Good understanding of Generative AI, Machine Learning, NLP, LLMs, and AI-driven product strategies.
* Experience working with AI/ML platforms such as Azure ML, Databricks, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face, or similar ecosystems.
* Understanding of MLOps concepts including model lifecycle management, monitoring, versioning, and deployment practices.
* Experience collaborating with data science, engineering, and AI teams to deliver AI-powered solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proven ability to influence business and technology stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.
* Ability to thrive in fast-paced environments and manage changing priorities effectively.
* Experience balancing business value, technical feasibility, customer needs, and compliance requirements.
* Good understanding of security, compliance, accessibility, and non-functional requirements.
* Product Owner certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe POPM, or equivalent are highly desirable.

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package

* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

------------------

OpenGov is seeking a Product Engineer to own key foundational areas of our Public Service Platform, leading cross-functional efforts, executing discovery, and driving delivery from spec through launch. These service areas include our Identity and Access Management capabilities, powering secure access for government users, public users, and internal staff. This is the career-level role: someone who operates independently, communicates proactively, and takes clear accountability for product outcomes while leveraging AI-native tooling for execution.

**How AI Works in This Role**
-----------------------------

AI-native tooling handles a significant portion of what product managers and UX designers have historically spent their time on. That time is yours to redirect toward higher-leverage work. Specifically:

* **Spec writing:** AI drafts the first spec from your intent statement. You review, sharpen, and own what gets built.
* **UX design:** AI generates mockups from the design system based on your flow definitions. Experience Architects maintain the system itself. You make the product decisions within it.
* **Shipping code:** AI helps you ship features alongside engineering counterparts, this is no longer a handoff but now a process where everyone ships.
* **Research synthesis:** AI clusters and themes interview notes, call transcripts, and support data. You interpret what it means for the roadmap and make the call.
* **Release content:** AI generates release notes, in-app announcements, and enablement materials from your shipped features.
* **Code review:** Automated review catches style, security, and regression issues. You stay accountable for quality outcomes — not the review queue.
* **Test coverage:** AI generates test cases from the acceptance criteria you write. Your job is to write criteria that are precise enough to verify.
* **Competitive intelligence:** AI monitors competitor moves and surfaces market signals. You form the point of view and decide what it means for your roadmap.

*What AI does not do: understand your customers, make the call on what matters, own the outcome, or build the cross-functional trust that makes things ship. That is the job.*

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Define and communicate the product vision for your area - grounded in customer research, competitive context, and business goals; not inherited from a committee.

* Track adoption, usage, and business outcome metrics; use them to drive the next iteration, not just to report status.
* Represent your product in customer conversations, QBRs, and cross-functional reviews — the full commercial picture, not just the feature set.
* Identify gaps in AI harnesses and design system coverage; surface them as platform investment requests with clear business justification.

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.

**Senior Manager Product and Lifecycle Management**

Medline India was established in 2010 in Pune as Global Capability Center to support Medline, headquartered in Illinois, USA. Over the years, it has grown into a 1,800+ strong team of technology, finance, and business support professionals who contribute to Medline’s global mission: to make healthcare run better. Medline India offers a dynamic and collaborative work environment with ample opportunities to learn, innovate, and grow. With a highly engaged and empowered team, Medline India plays a vital role in driving business excellence and supporting healthcare systems across the globe.

  

**Job Summary:**

Lead and integrate a global operations capability supporting the lifecycle of healthcare products and procedure kits, from product and component setup through controlled changes, commercial enablement, inventory management and discontinuation. The role connects product information, technical documentation, supply chain execution and business analytics to improve product availability, data quality, turnaround time and financial outcomes.

The Senior Manager will lead through managers and team leaders, establish a common operating model across the combined teams, and partner with global Product Management, Supply Chain, Commercial, Quality and Regulatory, and Technology leaders. The mandate includes building specialist talent, delivering reliable operations, and converting analytics, automation and AI opportunities into measurable improvements.

  

**Business scope**
------------------

· Kitting and lifecycle operations: new and revised kit setup, bill of materials maintenance, component changes, kit activation and closure, discontinued business, inventory disposition and lifecycle exceptions.

· Product information and technical support: product master data, technical data sheets, labeling and instructions for use support, packaging information, translations, product cross references and controlled documentation.

· Commercial and supply chain enablement: quotations and pricing support, vendor and sourcing administration, product availability and backorder insights, tender information and coordination across product divisions.

· Analytics and transformation: business intelligence, product and component analysis, workflow automation, project governance, process standardization and capability expansion.

  

**Responsibilities:**

**Product and lifecycle accountabilities**
==========================================

**Kitting and lifecycle operations**
------------------------------------

· Own service delivery for kit and component setup, bill of materials changes, revisions, activation and closure. Establish checks that keep approved product, quotation, packaging and system information consistent across handoffs.

· Coordinate new, revised and discontinued business with Product Management, planning, manufacturing, purchasing and customer-facing teams. Manage dependencies, exceptions and escalation to protect continuity of supply.

· Lead the operational response to excess, obsolete and expiring inventory, component shortages, revision runout and customer cancellations. Use analysis to recommend transfers, returns, purchase order actions or disposition for approval by the accountable business owner.

**Product data and documentation**
----------------------------------

· Establish ownership and quality controls for product attributes, descriptions, packaging hierarchies, images, component data and cross references. Resolve data defects at source and maintain consistency across product information and ERP systems.

· Oversee technical data sheet creation and updates, labeling and artwork coordination, instructions for use documentation, translation workflows and document publication. Maintain version control, traceability and evidence of required reviews.

· Strengthen controls for product changes, component discontinuations and related document updates so that approved changes reach the affected systems, users and downstream processes.

**Technical and product development support**
---------------------------------------------

· Lead the assigned support for supplier information, product specifications, sample review coordination, packaging study documentation and project milestones. Ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies and outstanding decisions are clearly documented.

· Partner with Product Management, Quality and Regulatory specialists on technical reviews and change decisions. Exercise approval authority only within formally assigned responsibilities and approved procedures.

**Commercial and supplier enablement**
--------------------------------------

· Oversee quotation and pricing administration, component cost and margin analysis, product replacement information, tender responses and product documentation requests. Ensure business recommendations use validated information and reach the authorized decision maker.

· Direct assigned vendor setup, vendor data maintenance, purchasing support and pricing or invoice exception workflows. Improve coordination with Procurement, Finance and global commercial teams.

· Improve availability and backorder support by connecting inventory, production schedules, component constraints and product alternatives. Ensure customer-facing responses reflect approved product information and reliable supply assumptions.

  

**Transformation and leadership accountabilities**
==================================================

**Business analytics and decision support**
-------------------------------------------

· Build a prioritized analytics portfolio covering inventory exposure, expiry and obsolescence, component shortages, kit revisions, product availability, quotation economics, margin drivers and time to market.

· Translate business questions into data requirements, agreed definitions and actionable dashboards. Challenge data quality, assumptions and analytical conclusions, and ensure insights lead to documented decisions and follow-up actions.

**Automation and AI**
---------------------

· Sponsor process simplification and automation using suitable tools such as Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, RPA and system integrations. Define requirements, controls, testing, adoption and support arrangements with Technology partners.

· Develop AI use cases for extracting and validating product information, comparing document versions, assisting product cross referencing, summarizing exceptions and supporting stakeholder queries. Define evaluation criteria and human review for technical, quality and regulatory content.

· Own the business case and benefits realization for each initiative. Establish a baseline, measure capacity released and improvements in quality or cycle time, and validate financial benefits with Finance while accounting for delivery and ongoing support costs.

**People and capability leadership**
------------------------------------

· Lead managers, team leaders, analysts and domain specialists across the combined portfolio. Define accountabilities, performance expectations, succession coverage and decision rights at each level.

· Build specialist career paths in product lifecycle operations, product data, technical documentation, analytics and automation. Recruit and develop talent capable of taking on more complex global responsibilities.

· Create a common culture of ownership, problem solving and continuous learning. Coach leaders through change, resolve competing priorities and maintain employee engagement as scope and ways of working evolve.

**Global partnership and operational governance**
-------------------------------------------------

· Establish one service catalogue, demand and capacity process, performance scorecard and escalation framework. Lead business reviews with global stakeholders and align resources to business value, risk and service commitments.

· Manage delivery quality, turnaround time, backlog, productivity, controls, budget and continuity within delegated authority. Maintain current procedures, training records, access controls and reliable backup coverage.

· Shape a phased capability roadmap and lead new scope discovery, transition planning, knowledge transfer and stabilization. Define acceptance criteria, service ownership and controls before assuming additional work.

  

**Work Experience & Required Skills:**

· Typically 15 or more years of progressive experience across product operations, product lifecycle management, supply chain, technical business operations or global capability environments, with substantial responsibility for complex delivery portfolios.

· Demonstrated experience leading managers or team leaders across multiple specialist teams, including performance management, succession development, organizational change and global stakeholder engagement.

· Strong understanding of product and component data, bills of materials, lifecycle changes and cross-functional dependencies. Relevant experience may come from medical devices, healthcare products or other complex manufactured-product businesses.

· Proven delivery of analytics and automation initiatives with measurable business outcomes. Ability to assess analytical logic, data quality, technology options and benefits rather than relying solely on project status reporting.

· Commercial and operational acumen sufficient to evaluate inventory exposure, cost and margin implications, service trade-offs and the business case for capability expansion.

· Ability to work with senior international stakeholders, influence decisions without direct authority, communicate complex issues clearly and lead teams through ambiguity.

  

**Educational Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, supply chain, operations, business or a relevant discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred. Lean Six Sigma, project management, supply chain or product lifecycle qualifications are useful where supported by delivery experience.
* Preferred exposure includes regulated product documentation, kitting or configurable products, product information management and ERP systems, Power BI and the Microsoft Power Platform.
* Familiarity with SQL, data modeling, RPA or AI implementation strengthens the profile.
Relevant environments in the current scope include SAP, QAD, AS400, PIM, Medpack, NetQuote, Workfront and Smartsheet; expertise in every platform is not required.  

**About Medline India:**

We are a 1500+ strong and growing team of technology, finance & and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024.
  
We are an organization with a conducive work environment, ample opportunities to learn, contribute and grow with a highly empowered & engaged team. We encourage our people to share their best ideas and create new opportunities for our customers and ourselves to work together to solve today’s toughest healthcare challenges.
  
**About Medline Industries, LP:**  
Established in 1966, Medline Industries LP is a renowned global healthcare organization boasting 56 years of consecutive sales growth, exceeding $21 billion in annual sales. With a workforce of over 36,000 professionals spread across the globe, we operate in more than 125 countries and territories. As the largest privately held manufacturer and distributor of medical supplies in the United States, Medline is uniquely positioned to offer comprehensive products, education, and support across the continuum of care.

title: Senior Product Manager - Web Merchandising
description:
**About Williams\-Sonoma India Technology Center**

Williams\-Sonoma India Technology Center is the technology hub for Williams\-Sonoma, Inc., supporting global digital commerce, supply chain, enterprise platforms, and customer experiences across our portfolio of brands. The India Technology Center partners closely with global business and engineering teams to build scalable, resilient, and innovative platforms that serve millions of customers worldwide.


**About the Team**

The Merchandising Systems Product Management team is responsible for the technology platforms and tools that support the end\-to\-end product lifecycle across Williams\-Sonoma, Inc. brands, from initial item intake and item setup through product enrichment, merchandising, and publication across all channels.


Our ecosystem includes Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Information Management (PIM), Digital Asset Management (DAM), Web Assortment Management (WAM), and downstream eCommerce systems. Together, these capabilities enable our brands to manage product information, content, and assets efficiently at scale for our customers.


By improving these technology solutions, we help WSI bring new product assortments to market faster, improve product and content quality, reduce manual effort, and respond effectively to evolving product, market, and customer needs.


**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Merchandising Systems team at our India Technology Center in Pune.


Web merchandising is at the heart of WSI's eCommerce business, shaping how millions of products are brought to life across our brands and digital experiences. Your initial focus will be Web Assortment Management (WAM), a major multi\-year transformation replacing a legacy platform that has supported the business for more than 16 years. WAM will become the core platform for organizing, enriching, validating, reviewing, and publishing online assortments across WSI's eCommerce sites.


In this hands\-on role, you will translate product strategy into well\-defined capabilities and drive them through delivery and brand adoption. You will work closely with the Engineering team in Pune and partner with US\-based Product, business, UX, Architecture, and Technology teams. A US\-based Lead Product Manager will set overall WAM direction and priorities; within that direction, you will define requirements, make product decisions, manage dependencies, and drive assigned capabilities from concept through rollout.


A significant part of the role is helping brand users successfully adopt new WAM capabilities and processes. You will study current workflows, identify improvement opportunities, demonstrate new functionality, develop and deliver training, support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and guide users through the transition from legacy tools and processes.


WAM will be the primary focus as the platform is delivered, launched, and scaled. Over time, the role may expand to other enterprise merchandising and content platforms, including Digital Asset Management and Site Content Management.


**You're excited about this opportunity because you will...**

* Own product execution for assigned WAM capabilities and workstreams, translating product strategy and priorities into detailed requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans.
* Partner closely with the Pune Engineering team throughout the product development lifecycle, providing product context, resolving requirements questions, making trade\-offs, and ensuring delivered solutions achieve intended business outcomes.

* Partner with UX to translate complex business workflows into intuitive experiences for business users.

* Identify risks, requirements gaps, edge cases, and cross\-system dependencies early, and maintain a clear, actionable backlog that provides Engineering with the context needed for delivery.
* Lead or support UAT, including scenario definition, business\-user coordination, issue triage, and translation of findings into product improvements.
* Drive business readiness and adoption through stakeholder engagement, workflow documentation, product demonstrations, training and enablement, rollout support, and ongoing feedback.
* Measure product effectiveness using qualitative and quantitative feedback, including adoption, workflow efficiency, time to market, data quality, platform performance, and business\-user satisfaction.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, improve data quality, accelerate new assortment introduction, and help the business respond more quickly to product and market updates.
* Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, scope decisions, and trade\-offs clearly across US and India Product, Engineering, and business teams.

**Why you will love working at Williams\-Sonoma, Inc.**

* We're a successful, fast\-growing company with an entrepreneurial vibe.
* A technologically and data\-driven business.
* Competitive salaries and comprehensive health benefits.
* We're at the forefront of tech and retail, redefining technology for the next generation.
* We're passionate about our internal and external clients and live and breathe the client experience.
* We get to be creative on a daily basis.
* A smart, experienced leadership team that wants to do it right and is open to new ideas.
* We believe in autonomy and reward taking initiative.
**We're excited about you because...**

* You have 5\+ years of Product Management, Technical Product Management, or senior business systems experience delivering technology solutions.
* You have experience delivering complex enterprise platforms, internal business tools, or multi\-system programs with significant workflow and integration complexity, in close partnership with Engineering.
* You can translate business problems and workflows into detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and scalable technology solutions.
* You can balance business workflow and change\-management responsibilities with abstract technical concepts, complex platform architecture, attribution and data models, integrations, and system behavior.
* You have experience working with business operations users and driving change for enterprise tools or processes through stakeholder engagement, demonstrations, training, UAT, rollout support, and adoption.
* You bring strong analytical and problem\-solving skills and can identify edge cases, evaluate trade\-offs, and make decisions in ambiguous situations.
* You communicate clearly and operate effectively across geographically distributed Product, Engineering, business, and leadership teams.
* You hold a bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or have equivalent professional experience.
* You can work from our India Technology Center in Pune according to WSI's onsite and hybrid working requirements.

**Technical Competencies Required**

* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to engage meaningfully with engineers and architects on integrations, data models, system workflows, platform architecture, and technical trade\-offs.
* Ability to create clear product artifacts, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, prioritized backlogs, and delivery plans.
* Understanding of enterprise platform integrations and upstream and downstream dependencies across product information, digital asset, content, image, and eCommerce systems.
* Experience defining UAT scenarios, coordinating business validation, triaging issues, and converting findings into actionable product improvements.
* Ability to define and track product success measures such as adoption, workflow efficiency, time to market, data quality, platform performance, and user satisfaction.

**Preferred Experience**

* Knowledge of retail, eCommerce, merchandising, product information, content management, or digital asset management.
* Experience with platforms such as PLM, PIM, DAM, CMS/WCM, WAM, vendor portals, or merchandising systems.
* Experience supporting enterprise platform modernization, legacy\-system replacement, or multi\-year transformation programs.

**Why Join Williams\-Sonoma India Technology Center**

* Our people\-first and performance\-driven culture means that we provide opportunities to grow and build a career, and invest in the well\-being of our associates, including comprehensive benefits to support you and your family.

* Continuous learning environment with opportunities to work on cutting\-edge technologies, AI\-driven solutions, and large\-scale technology challenges.

Lead Product Manager \- Technical

Overview
  

  

The Mastercard Dispute Lifecycle team in Pune have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Management \- Technical to help further enhance and modernize our Dispute management platform.  

  

The ideal candidate will quickly develop a deep technical understanding of the applications and systems they support, demonstrating a willingness to dive in, challenge assumptions, and ask thoughtful, probing questions to ensure plans are executed effectively and efficiently.  

  

They will bring a strong interest in Payments domain, along with proven technical leadership, and the ability to think creatively applying innovative, out\-of\-the\-box approaches to solve complex problems  

  

Role
  

  

* Customer obsession: Champion a deep understanding of customer needs, the broader ecosystem, and key market dynamics, and embed these insights into product decisions
* Systems analysis \& design: Develop an in\-depth understanding of the product platform and its surrounding ecosystem; produce high\-quality functional artifacts for Engineering, including data flows, sequence diagrams, APIs, and interface specifications
* Backlog management: Define and maintain a clear roadmap aligned to business objectives; translate system designs into well\-structured features and user stories that are ready for Engineering execution
* Story elaboration: Lead refinement sessions and create detailed, comprehensive acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and delivery readiness
* Technical analysis: Provide rigorous analysis of application software to validate that business and functional requirements can be effectively delivered
* Strategic alignment: Partner with stakeholders to ensure backlogs are prioritized and refined based on business value, impact, and measurable outcomes
* Agile mindset: Advocate for and model agile best practices across the product lifecycle—from defining epics to writing actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Continuous improvement: Measure outcomes, evaluate existing practices and metrics, and drive ongoing optimization across processes, roles, and delivery execution

  

All About You
  

  

* Proven product experience: Several years of product management or new product development experience delivering high\-quality products, with the ability to clearly articulate business context and customer use cases
* Technical product expertise: Experience managing highly technical platforms or API\-driven services, with strong software architecture and systems design knowledge
* ISO8583 knowledge (preferred): Familiarity with key payments and dispute management concepts is a plus
* Lean \& Agile delivery: Hands\-on experience with Lean product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
* End\-to\-end ownership: Demonstrated success delivering features from design through development, deployment, and customer integration
* Backlog management: Expertise in grooming epics, features, and user stories; defining clear acceptance and exit criteria; and effectively prioritizing platform backlogs
* Data\-driven decision making: Ability to define and leverage SMART metrics (leading and lagging) to guide product strategy and measure success
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across global, cross\-functional teams, align diverse perspectives, and manage dependencies and co\-development opportunities
* Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty; proactively identifies solutions, engages the right stakeholders, and drives clarity
* Continuous improvement \& communication: Committed to optimizing team processes for speed, quality, and innovation, with excellent written and verbal communication skills
